Louisiana’s Most Dependable Service and Truck Leasing Companies

In 1983, we opened our doors as a small International truck dealer in Alexandria, Louisiana. Today, Timmons is a household name in the industry. How did we get here? To those unfamiliar with the Timmons family, it can sound like a fairy tale. The truth is, it took 40 years of hard work and thousands of gallons of elbow grease.

Locally-owned and family-operated, Timmons Truck Center has grown into one of the best International truck dealers in Louisiana because of an unwavering passion for anything that hauls, dumps, or lifts. In four decades, our first-class truck mechanics have seen it all – and fixed it.

We take care of our trucks, our customers, and our hard-working diesel and truck mechanics. That’s how you build anything worth holding onto. That’s how we built Timmons.

Since its humble beginnings as a small family-owned venture in 1983 in Alexandria, Louisiana, Timmons has risen to prominence in the industry. What has led us to where we are today? It took 40 years, marked by relentless gear shifts and gallons of hard-earned sweat equity. Timmons Truck Center has grown from a trucking company to Louisiana’s top international truck dealer due to its love for moving, carrying, and lifting. Over four decades, we’ve faced every challenge head-on, emerging victorious each time. At the core of Timmons lies an unwavering commitment from our dedicated team of expert diesel and truck mechanics, ensuring seamless truck operations, attentive client service, and an enduring dedication that stands the test of time. from parts to purchasing or leasing, we are here to serve, and your journey deserves nothing but the best!
